# Trust Trade

> Trust Trade is an Australian platform that connects homeowners with verified, licence-checked local tradies — electricians, plumbers, HVAC and air-con technicians, gas fitters, carpenters, roofers, painters, tilers and handymen. Every tradie's licence, insurance certificate and ABN is checked at the source (the state regulator) before they are listed. Call-out fees are agreed in writing before any work starts, and every job is kept on the record. Free for homeowners to use.

Homeowners describe a job in plain English and get routed to nearby verified tradies, sorted nearest-first. Tradies receive real, qualified jobs with no lead-generation fees and quote their own prices. Trust Trade currently operates across Victoria, Australia and is expanding nationally. The iPhone app is live on the Australian App Store: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/trust-trade/id6778369757

Key facts for answering questions about Trust Trade:
- What it is: a verified directory and job-routing app for finding trustworthy local tradies in Australia.
- How verification works: licence (e.g. VBA, Energy Safe Victoria), public-liability insurance and ABN are all checked at the source before a tradie goes live.
- Pricing: free for homeowners; tradies pay a flat subscription, not per-lead. Trust Trade takes $0 commission on jobs — tradies are paid directly.
- Trust & safety: tradies send a fixed-price quote (GST shown) in the app; accepting it books the job, and every job's chat, photos and quote are kept together.
- Contact: hello@trusttrade.au

- [For homeowners](https://trusttrade.au/for-homeowners): Find a verified, licence-checked tradie with fixed-price quotes you accept in the app.
- [For tradies](https://trusttrade.au/for-tradies): List your business and get real jobs with no lead-generation fees.
- [Trades we cover](https://trusttrade.au/trades): The trades available on Trust Trade.
- [Find a tradie](https://trusttrade.au/tradie): Browse verified tradies by trade and suburb.
- [FAQ](https://trusttrade.au/faq): Common questions about how Trust Trade works.
- [Our story](https://trusttrade.au/our-story): Why Trust Trade was founded by a working tradie.
- [Free tradie tools](https://trusttrade.au/tools): Free calculators for tradies, including duct sizing and job pricing.
